dependencies.artifact: q1 independent full roundtrips A and B
dependencies.required_evidence: Both source receipts and their independent soft-pressure verifications are terminal passes with byte-identical package, payload, archive, and inverse.
One retained single-link report produced on the execution host identifies Geekbench 5 and contains exactly one positive single-core score.
Runtime compression uses the Arm A packaged compressor and head by exact path, byte count, and SHA-256; its new payload and archive must reproduce A/B.

contract.new_archive_rule: The prize-timed compression phase must regenerate a payload and archive byte-identical to both independently verified q1 full arms before decompression starts.
contract.decoder_input_rule: The guarded decompression command receives only the newly generated self-extracting archive. It receives no canonical-corpus path; exactness is determined from the restored file's fixed byte count and SHA-256.
contract.inverse_rule: The prize-timed decompression phase must restore all 1,000,000,000 canonical bytes exactly.
contract.provenance_rule: The producer and verifier independently recompute the transitive Python/schema closure and exact command vectors; path inclusion alone is insufficient.
contract.failure_rule: A terminal failure retains guarded stage evidence and scratch state, releases the managed lease when safe, emits a false terminal receipt, and grants no runtime authority.

activation_requirements: qm8 Arm A and one independently planned Arm B are terminal exact passes with independent verification
the selected host has a retained raw Geekbench 5 report and stable fingerprint
the exclusive full-1G lease and its acquisition lock are absent
all implementation, schema, plan, and transitive source-closure hashes match this revision
result, scratch, cgroup, and lease-transition paths are new and disjoint
kill_condition: Any antecedent, source closure, command, package, host, guard, runtime, inverse, cleanup, or independent-verification mismatch ends this runtime candidate with zero authority.
